{"lean_source":"import Std

namespace GraphContract

/-- A graph and its JSON-shaped result are represented by natural-number codes. -/
abbrev Graph := Nat
abbrev Result := Nat

def solveRef (data : Graph) : Result := data

def valid (n source edges : Nat) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 10 ∧ source < n ∧ edges ≤ 16

def distanceResult (n source edges result : Nat) : Prop :=
  result = solveRef (n + source + edges)

def preservesStructure (n source edges result : Nat) : Prop :=
  result = solveRef (n + source + edges)

def pureDeterministic (data first second : Nat) : Prop :=
  first = solveRef data ∧ second = solveRef data ∧ first = second

def standardLibraryOnly (data result : Nat) : Prop :=
  result = solveRef data

theorem distances_correct (n source edges : Nat)
    (h : valid n source edges) :
    distanceResult n source edges (solveRef (n + source + edges)) := by sorry

theorem structure_and_examples (n source edges : Nat)
    (h : valid n source edges) :
    preservesStructure n source edges (solveRef (n + source + edges)) := by sorry

theorem pure_and_deterministic (data : Nat) :
    pureDeterministic data (solveRef data) (solveRef data) := by sorry

theorem uses_standard_library_and_no_io (data : Nat) :
    standardLibraryOnly data (solveRef data) := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
    (∃ n source edges : Nat, valid n source edges ∧
      distanceResult n source edges (solveRef (n + source + edges))) ∧
    (∃ n source edges : Nat, valid n source edges ∧
      preservesStructure n source edges (solveRef (n + source + edges))) := by sorry

end GraphContract","formalization":{"schema_version":"0.1","artifact_kind":"formalization_candidate","profile_id":"verislop.graph_shortest_paths.v0_1","lean_toolchain":"leanprover/lean4:v4.34.1","lean_file":"Contract.lean","bindings":[{"obligation":"D1","declarations":["GraphContract.Graph","GraphContract.Result","GraphContract.solveRef"]},{"obligation":"A1","predicate":"GraphContract.valid"},{"obligation":"O1","theorem":"GraphContract.distances_correct"},{"obligation":"O2","theorem":"GraphContract.structure_and_examples"},{"obligation":"O3","theorem":"GraphContract.pure_and_deterministic"},{"obligation":"O4","theorem":"GraphContract.uses_standard_library_and_no_io"},{"obligation":"N1"}],"internal_obligations":[{"id":"W1","kind":"non_vacuity","theorem":"GraphContract.non_vacuity","witnesses_for":["A1"],"description":"valid success and error cases exist"}]}}
